entry: 01:00 UTC open after 00:00 decision; 6 feeds complete
exit: next UTC day 01:00 open, or stop earlier; no simultaneous new position before old exit
policy: single portfolio capital slot; no same-time duplicate exposure; cash if no positive momentum
primary_rank: momentum * multiplier; choose highest positive; tie lexicographic symbol
ranking_time: each UTC date 00:00:00 from 24 complete prior hourly bars; trade enters at 01:00 UTC NEXT hour open (one-hour conservative availability lag)
risk: fixed initial stop = entry - 2*Wilder ATR(14) as of prior completed 23:00 hourly bar. Stop intrabar at fixed level; unfavorable gap at actual open.
same_bar: stop wins, no invented favorable fills
source_mapping: Volume-weighted cryptocurrency TSMOM motivates the broad hypothesis; THIS daily single-long ranking, horizons, cap and stop are independently authored ZEL rules, NOT a replication of published market-neutral portfolio.
volume_multiplier: last24h summed base volume / mean(preceding 7 non-overlapping 24h volumes), capped 3, excludes current day from denominator
